events.title: Lady Jane Grey is proclaimed Queen of England
events.description: Days after Edward VI's death, the Duke of Northumberland had his Protestant daughter-in-law proclaimed queen to bar the Catholic Mary Tudor. Jane's reign lasted nine days; she was executed the following year.
events.html: Days after Edward VI's death, the Duke of Northumberland had his Protestant daughter-in-law proclaimed queen to bar the Catholic Mary Tudor. Jane's reign lasted nine days; she was executed the following year.

events.title: William the Silent is assassinated in Delft
events.description: Balthasar Gérard shot William of Orange, leader of the Dutch revolt against Spain, at his home in Delft. He is often cited as the first head of state killed with a handgun.
events.html: Balthasar Gérard shot William of Orange, leader of the Dutch revolt against Spain, at his home in Delft. He is often cited as the first head of state killed with a handgun.

events.title: Wyoming becomes the 44th US state
events.description: Wyoming joined the Union with women's suffrage intact; as a territory it had given women the vote in 1869. Congress accepted the state despite opposition to its equal-suffrage clause.
events.html: Wyoming joined the Union with women's suffrage intact; as a territory it had given women the vote in 1869. Congress accepted the state despite opposition to its equal-suffrage clause.

events.title: The Scopes 'Monkey Trial' opens in Tennessee
events.description: Teacher John Scopes went on trial in Dayton for teaching human evolution. The clash between Clarence Darrow and William Jennings Bryan turned a local case into a national debate on science and faith.
events.html: Teacher John Scopes went on trial in Dayton for teaching human evolution. The clash between Clarence Darrow and William Jennings Bryan turned a local case into a national debate on science and faith.

events.title: The Battle of Britain begins
events.description: The Luftwaffe began attacking Channel convoys and coastal targets, the date Britain uses for the start of the Battle of Britain. The RAF's survival over four months forced Hitler to postpone his invasion.
events.html: The Luftwaffe began attacking Channel convoys and coastal targets, the date Britain uses for the start of the Battle of Britain. The RAF's survival over four months forced Hitler to postpone his invasion.

events.title: Telstar is launched, the first satellite to relay live TV
events.description: NASA launched AT&T's Telstar 1 from Cape Canaveral. Within hours it relayed the first television pictures across the Atlantic, opening the age of satellite communications.
events.html: NASA launched AT&T's Telstar 1 from Cape Canaveral. Within hours it relayed the first television pictures across the Atlantic, opening the age of satellite communications.
